evidence.title: Spotby — Spots people trust App - App Store

name: Spotby — Spots people trust
summary: iPhone app that turns saved food videos into a map of cafés, restaurants and bars from creators.
description: Spotby is a map of places worth going, curated from creator recommendations rather than algorithms: follow local tastemakers city by city, watch the video behind each pin, and navigate straight there. Food & Drink category; free with in-app purchases; by Signer Labs.
contains: saved food videos become map pins
follow creators and see their spots on one map
free with in-app purchases; Food & Drink category
